environment.apiMode: All /api/** requests intercepted by Playwright routes; no backend or database

assertions: Mobile account opener is visible at 320×800
Login dialog, email, password, and submit button are fully in the viewport
Document and dialog have no horizontal overflow before or after the error appears
Invalid credentials are exposed as the expected role=alert text
Translucent alert text contrast is at least 4.5:1
Configured axe WCAG tags report no violations in the login dialog
limitations: This is automated browser evidence with mocked API responses, not backend or database integration evidence.
The Playwright viewport is 320 CSS px, not actual browser zoom or physical-device testing.
The result does not verify screen-reader speech or complete manual WCAG conformance; manual checklist outcomes remain unchanged.
The rechecks set the page viewport to 320×800 CSS px in both Chromium projects; they do not represent physical mobile hardware or actual browser zoom.
